Jeff, I'm sorry. You ordered in July, we missed October 15 and then October 30, and you're still waiting.

Here's where it stands right now. Your Power K. and Miner D. are set aside for you at our Chattanooga warehouse. The B30 itself hasn't arrived there yet, so nothing has shipped. I won't give you another date I can't stand behind.

I've sent your order to the team to get a firm ship date, along with your earlier request about the missed date. Someone will get back to you with an answer at (email hidden)

You can track the batch here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
